purpose: Create immutable authorization policy versions, append-only publication history, an atomic current-policy pointer, and append-only authorization decision evidence.
lockImpact: Creates a new module-owned schema and empty tables only.
dataImpact: No Permission, Role, Grant, administrator, approval route, organization fact, or CRM data is seeded.
backfill: Not required. Production remains not ready until an authorized owner publishes a reviewed complete non-empty policy through application composition.
recovery: Before first use this reserved migration may be corrected during review. After any policy or decision fact exists, stop writers and roll application code back while retaining the schema and history; do not drop or rewrite immutable facts.
forwardFix: After first application, use a newly reserved reviewed forward migration. Restore an earlier policy by appending a new publication fact and atomically moving the current pointer, never by editing history.
